title: Macro Tightening Composite vs Bitcoin Risk
note: risk-v1 · Equal-weighted mean of three FRED series — broad dollar, 10-year Treasury and the Chicago Fed's NFCI — each z-scored against ONLY the history available at that date, on a 365-day warm-up. A full-sample z-score would draw 2014 using 2022's distribution, which is the mistake this whole product is organised against. The level correlation is not quoted because both series trend; the daily-change figure is the honest one.
subtitle: Three series that all say "tighter" in different units, put on a common scale and averaged.
